With its uncompromising blend of power, handling, and premium features, the 2019 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 is a true masterpiece of automotive engineering. If you're seeking a thrilling, high-performance sports car that can also pamper you with modern conveniences, this Camaro is the perfect choice. description:
Up for sale is a stunning relic way back from the 1900's. The precise year is 1996. According to the odometer, this Jeep Cherokee SE Sport Utility 2D has traveled 236,105 miles of Southern California highways and byways.

The original color was green, however it boldly transitioned to an eye-catching bumble bee yellow. It's powered by a 6-cylinder, 4.0-liter engine paired with a 5-speed manual transmission and 2WD.

While we are not exactly the original owners, this jeep has been in the family since 1996, changing hands from my uncle, to my parents, to my sister, and has been in my hands for 18 years now. It is the vehicle I learned to drive stick in. But alas, because of life circumstances, it sits in our driveway, unused. It is dying to go on more desert adventures or get a proper makeover.

There is obviously no denying it: this is visually somewhat of a project piece. It runs great, though, including the AC, and we've actually had to do very little work on it. We changed out the clutch, I know that. It's seriously such a BEAST.
In full transparency, it has seen three accidents many years ago (none by us), but they were minor, and this beauty still maintains a clean title.

This Jeep has been a reliable companion for many adventures. If you have any questions or want to see it in person, feel free to reach out!

2019 Lexus RC 350 factory-default equipment overview

Powertrain and performance
- 3.5-liter naturally aspirated V6 engine paired to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The V6 is tuned for strong mid-range power and smooth operation appropriate for a luxury sport coupe.
- Rear-wheel drive is standard; all-wheel drive was offered as an available option. Drive-mode selections (including Normal and Sport settings) enable a balance between comfort and more responsive throttle/shift mapping.

Chassis and handling
- Independent suspension with tuned components to deliver a balance of composed ride quality and athletic handling. Braking is handled by ventilated disc brakes with antilock braking system (ABS) and electronic brake-force distribution.
- Stability and traction control systems are standard to help maintain control in varying driving conditions.

Exterior
- Coupe body with a low roofline, pronounced front fascia and integrated rear spoiler styling characteristic of the RC line.
- Projector and LED lighting elements for daytime running lights and taillights; automatic lighting controls are included. Exterior conveniences such as power mirrors and keyless entry are factory-standard.

Interior and comfort
- Two-door, four-seat configuration with supportive front bucket seats designed for longer trips and spirited driving. Factory seating materials vary by trim (NuLuxe or leather trim depending on package).
- Power-adjustable front seats with driver memory settings and standard heating for the front seats; ventilation and upgraded upholstery are available on higher trims or packages.
- Dual-zone automatic climate control, tilt/telescoping steering column, illuminated vanity mirrors and a center console with storage and cupholders are standard.

Infotainment and connectivity
- Lexus multimedia system with a centrally mounted display and Remote Touch controller (touchpad/knob interface) for menu navigation. Screen size and system configuration vary by trim and option packages.
- Factory connectivity includes Bluetooth hands-free phone and audio streaming, USB and auxiliary inputs, HD Radio and a standard backup camera. SiriusXM satellite radio, navigation and upgraded premium audio systems are available options or included on higher trims.

Overall, the 2019 Lexus RC 350 ships from the factory as a well-appointed luxury sport coupe focused on a refined V6 driving experience, a feature set that blends comfort and technology, and a range of available performance and luxury upgrades to suit different buyer preferences.
